notes.title: SWORN 1.0 is LIVE (v1.0.0.1.1002 Release Notes)
notes.notes:
[h1]General Changes[/h1]

- New Final Boss phase for Arthur, available on Baron difficulty and above
- New Potion System:
    - Add an additional edge to combat with flasks you can choose before each run. Speak to Guinevere to unlock the potion station.
    - Find the Fae Lord shrines on your run to unlock their special flask, allowing you to guarantee a blessing from a specific Fae, at the cost of taking your potion slot
- Additional Voice Acting and dialogue throughout the entire game
- Networking Stability Improvements
- Performance Improvements on lower end machines
- Polished VFX and Enemy Textures

[h1]Blessing Changes & Bugfixes[/h1]

- Updated most Weapon and Spell Blessing icons
- Venom, Immolate, and Bleed now correctly benefit from effects that boost all damage like the Devotion Tree’s Chaos upgrade
- Updated Mab’s Bile and all related blessings to fire in an arc. Waste Not and Chemical X only fire if there’s a target in range. Updated targeting for Venomous Demise, Mab’s Ultimate, to be an area of effect targeter.
- Fixed the Oberon Blessing Closed Circuit requiring every Chain Lightning Blessing to acquire, rather than just any of them
- Fixed Oberon Whirlwinds not triggering the Typhoon Blessing
- Fixed Grave Weakness Blessing stacking when it wasn’t supposed to be
- Fixed an issue where the player was able to apply Infect to bombs and traps
- Fix Cliona’s Fate Weaver Blessing not applying to Merlin or Morgana blessings
- Badb’s Channeled Darkness will correctly proc backstabs if dealt by Oberon’s Ultimate if in Flow
- Fixed Beira’s Deep Chill Roundtable Blessing sometimes not affecting the entire party

[h1]Weapons & Spells[/h1]

[h2]General Ability Changes[/h2]
- Abilities with cooldowns will no longer go on cooldown if the ability is cancelled

[h2]Vigilante[/h2]
[h3]Sword[/h3]
- [b]Light Attack Combo[/b]: Final hit is now a slash that covers a larger area, rather than a stab
- [b]Blade Wave Blessing[/b]: Base Damage increased from 15 to 20.
- [b]Blade Wave Blessing[/b]: Now properly uses your Light Attack’s Blessing
- [b]Blade Wave Blessing[/b]: Now works on all three hits in the combo.
- [b]Fencing Foil Augment[/b]: Damage reduced from 60% to 50%
- [b]Long Sword Augment[/b]: Damage reduced from 20% to 15%
- [b]Long Sword Augment[/b]: Range reduced from 30% to 20%
- [b]Double Edge Blessing[/b]: More favorably interacts with cooldown reduction effects like Whirlpool
- [b]Double Edge Blessing[/b]: Now adds a -25% damage penalty to the attack
- [b]Magnesis Blessing[/b]: Range Bonus decreased from 250% to 100%

[h3]Bow[/h3]
- [b]Light Attack[/b]: Full Charge Damage increased from 40 to 50
- [b]Heavy Attack[/b]: Can now be charged and has a Perfect Shot mechanic if released at the right time for additional damage
- [b]Heavy Attack[/b]: Cooldown decreased from 2.25 to 1.25 seconds

[h3]Bo Staff[/h3]
- [b]Light Attack[/b]: Combo final hit Base Damage decreased from 50 to 40
- [b]Heavy Attack[/b]: Made some timing tweaks to hopefully make it feel smoother to use
- [b][NEW] Heavy Impact[/b]: Added new Blessing that causes Heavy Attack to deal Knockback and can Wall Slam
- [b][NEW] Light Impact[/b]: Added new Blessing that causes Light Attack to deal Additional Damage and a small amount of Knockback

[h2]Rook[/h2]
[h3]Great Hammer[/h3]
- [b]Light Attack[/b]: Combo Damage changed from 55/55/125 to 60/60/120
- [b]Light Dash Attack[/b]: Slightly increased animation speed
- [b]Heavy Attack[/b]: Base Spin Damage increased from 55 to 60
- [b]Heavy Attack[/b]: Movement Speed while charging has been greatly increased
- [b]Spin Cycle Augment[/b]: Now also increased movement speed while charging
- [b]Spin Cycle Augment[/b]: Speed bonus reduced from 80% to 75%
- [b]Spring Loaded Augment[/b]: Now has an additional 20% damage bonus
- [b]Fully Wound Blessing[/b]: Now has an additional 30% damage bonus
- [b]Axis of Rotation Blessing[/b]: Maximum Damage Bonus 40% → 50%
- [b]Inertial Strength Blessing[/b]: Now also causes spins to charge faster
- [b][NEW] Star Swinger[/b]: Added new Blessing that increases Light Attack Speed and Damage

[h3]Hand Cannon[/h3]
- [b]Light Attack[/b]: Base Damage decreased from 85 to 80
- [b]Overheat[/b]: Duration decreased from 6 seconds to 4 seconds
- [b]Heavy Attack[/b]: Base Damage decreased from 75 to 60
- [b]Mighty Windup Augment[/b]: Fixed an issue where uncharged damage was sometimes counted as partially charged
- [b][NEW] Hot Steel[/b]: Added a new Blessing Heavy Attack deals bonus damage while Overheated

[h3]Halberd[/h3]
- [b]Cleave Augment[/b]: Fixed an issue where the final level of Cleave cost more Grail Water than intended
- [b][NEW] Edgebreaker[/b]: Added a new Blessing that causes your Light Attack to deal more damage the further you are from your target
- [b][NEW] Twin Lunge[/b]: Added a new Blessing that causes your Heavy Attack to apply On-Hit effects twice and deal more Damage

[h3]Gauntlets[/h3]
- [b]Heavy Dash Attack[/b]: Damage decreased from 60 to 40
- [b]Heavy Dash Attack[/b]: Animation has been sped up slightly and can be Dash cancelled sooner
- [b][NEW] Barraging Beatdown[/b]: Added a new Blessing that causes the fifth consecutive Light Attack on a Foe to deal additional Damage
- [b][NEW] Sucker Punch[/b]: Added a new Blessing that causes your Heavy Attack to deal bonus Damage to Foes with full health
- [b][NEW] Faithful Fighter[/b]: Added a new Blessing that causes both Light Attack and Heavy Attack to build Ultimate meter faster

[h3]Spells[/h3]
- [b]Counter[/b]: Fixed an issue where  could sometimes transfer it’s on-hit effects to your next attack

[h2]Monk[/h2]
[h3]Mace[/h3]
- [b]Light Attack[/b]: Combo damage increased from 35/35/50 to 40/40/60
- [b][NEW] Echo Bolts[/b]: Added a new Blessing that gives Heavy Attack Bolts a chance to deal double damage and apply on-hit effects twice.

[h3]Magic Staff[/h3]
- [b]Light Attack[/b]: Fixed an issue where sometimes the area of effect of the Light Attack would be smaller or larger than intended when taking specific Blessing combinations
- [b][NEW] Accelerator[/b]: Added a Blessing that increases the Speed and Damage of Light Attack projectiles
- [b][NEW] Arcane Ailment[/b]: Added a Blessing that causes Foes struck by your Heavy Attack to take additional Damage from Spells.
- [b][NEW] Piercing Arcanery[/b]: Added a Blessing that causes your Light Attack to pierce Foes

[h3]Tome[/h3]
- [b]Heavy Attack[/b]: Can now be charged and has a Perfect Shot mechanic for bonus Damage
- [b]Heavy Attack[/b]: Cooldown decreased from 1.5 seconds to 1 second
- [b]Heavy Attack[/b]: Base Damage decreased from 70 to 40

[h3]Chimes[/h3]
- Fixed an issue where Chimes could not break Destructibles
- [b]Light Attack[/b]: Base Damage increased from 12 to 15
- [b]Heavy Attack[/b]: Cooldown decreased from 1.5 seconds to 1.25 seconds

[h3]Spells[/h3]
- [b]Storm Call[/b]: Base Damage increased from 18 to 20

[h2]Specter[/h2]
[h3]Armillary Sphere[/h3]
- [b]Light Attack[/b]: Base Spread increased from 10 degrees to 30 degrees
- [b]Light Attack[/b]: Base Damage increased from 8 to 10
- [b]Heavy Attack[/b]: Cooldown decreased from 1.75 seconds to 1.5 seconds
- [b]Heavy Attack[/b]: Base Damage increased from 75 to 80
- [b]Heavy Attack[/b]: Speed increased slightly
- [b][NEW] Scatter Bolts[/b]: Added a new Blessing that causes Heavy Attack to launch several smaller bolts after exploding
- [b][NEW] Homing Bolts[/b]: Added a new Blessing that causes Light Attack to deal more damage and have a tighter Spread
- [b][NEW] Gravity Well[/b]: Added a new Blessing that causes Heavy Attack to deal more damage and pull enemies in

[h3]Scythe[/h3]
- [b][NEW] Deathly Caster[/b]: Added a new Blessing that causes your Heavy Attack to deal more damage after using your Spell

[h3]Arcane Blade[/h3]
- [b]Spell Weaver Augment[/b]: Now resets when exiting a Chamber
- [b]Spell Weaver Augment[/b]: Fixed an interaction where the Spirit Companions Blessing Open the Floodgates could fully stack Spell Weaver by rapidly toggling the Spell
- [b]Heavy Attack[/b]: Reworked to fire a storm of rotating metal that advances slowly and deals damage over time to Foes caught in it
- [b]Mystic Smash Blessing[/b]: Removed
- [b]Weaving Slashes Blessing[/b]: Removed
- [b][NEW] Blade Torrent[/b]: Added a new Blessing that increases the frequency of your Heavy Attack’s damage over time
- [b][NEW] Unencumbered[/b]: Added a new Augment that increases the Damage of your Heavy Attack for each Blade you are missing
- [b][NEW] Mana Force[/b]: Added a new Augment that increases the Damage of your Heavy Attack for each empty Mana charge you have
- [b][NEW] Blade Mass[/b]: Added a new Blessing that increase the Damage and size of your Heavy Attack

[h3]Claws[/h3]
- [b]Heavy Attack[/b]: Has been swapped with the old Light Dash Attack area of effect sweep
- [b]Light Dash Attack[/b]: Has been swapped with the old Heavy Attack lunge
- [b]On The Prowl Augment[/b]: Removed
- [b]Demonic Pull[/b]: Has been changed from an Augment to a Sword in the Stone Blessing, and given an additional 30% Damage bonus.
- [b]Vampirism[/b]: Has been renamed to [b]Demonic Ritual[/b], changed from an Augment to a Sword in the Stone Blessing, and its duration increased from 3.25 seconds to 4 seconds.
- [b]Air Slash[/b]: Has been renamed to [b]Demonic Reach[/b], moved from a Sword in the Stone Blessing to an Augment, and had its bonus range reduced from 50% to 20%
- [b]Killing Spree Augment[/b]: Has been renamed to [b]Death Lust[/b] and Speed has been reduced from 25% to 20%
- [b]Wounding Lunge Augment[/b]: Renamed to [b]Lasting Devastation[/b]
- [b]Through Pain Blessing[/b]: Renamed to [b]Sacrificial Power[/b]
- [b][NEW] Rapid Devastation[/b]: Added a new Augment that significantly decreases your Heavy Attack’s Cooldown
- [b][NEW] Speed Demon[/b]: Added a new Augment that increases your Light Attack’s Damage and Movement Speed

[h1]Levels[/h1]

- First Encounters with Fisher King and Guinevere have their own special rooms
- Rest Area between biomes has been updated with new assets and layout

[h1]UI[/h1]

- Fixed damage taken and damage dealt in the post run screen not being correct in multiplayer
- Codex Blessings are now considered discovered when you take them, rather than just when you see them
- Fixed some codex blessings remaining locked in the UI, even if the blessings were seen and taken
- Fixed an exploit where you could earn more rewards from completing accolades by changing the difficulty in the lobby, collecting the accolade, then changing the difficulty back
- Fixed various camera bugs associated with locking on during cutscenes (you cannot do that anymore)
- Fixed various bugs related to rerolling Fae Lords
- Add toggle to show/hide boss HP numbers (default hidden)
- Updated Blessing UI, Codex UI, Emote UI, Architect UI
- Adjusted Lock On Reticle textures to be more readable
- New Dash UI to indicate when dash is off cooldown, and how many charges you have
- Added toggle for Gamepad Aim Assist (default on)

[h1]Enemies, Hazards & Corruptions[/h1]

- Fixed some fireballs in Camelot (Arthur, Mage Knight) either not hitting the player or not hitting terrain
- Added Fireworks traps to a variety of Cornwall levels
- Added a general change to mob AI - mobs will now attack or chase you if you hit them from outside their aggression range. Some mob behavior in multiplayer has also changed as a result, certain mobs will now more aggressively target players dealing damage to them
- Adjusted Raving Blight to be slower, more anticipation and recovery on the triple claw attack, and bouncing projectiles to travel slower
- Nerfed Knight Statue trap in the roundtable room Damage from 30 to 15
- Fixed Revival Seal corruption causing you to lose all revival seals if you die and are resurrected by a friend after combat is over
- Made Lancelot’s Combat Challenge in earlier biomes easier by reducing the health of the summoned Knights
- Increased Exploding Rats stun duration from 0.5 seconds to 1 second
- Major Mosquito is immune to knockback like other Major Enemies
- Mobs now wiggle a bit when you hit them for better feedback

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]

Tons of additional small bugfixes

notes.title: King Arthur inspired Hades 2 rival shifts release date to dodge nightmare clash
notes.notes:
Hades 2 finally has a date for its 1.0 launch, and that's exciting news for just about everyone. But for Sworn developer Windwalk Games, it's a bit of a nightmare situation. Of all the newcomers that draw inspiration from one of the best roguelike games around, this King Arthur-themed offering is one of the closest to Hades in form and structure. Unfortunately, its planned 1.0 release happened to be Thursday September 25 - the same day now claimed by Supergiant's titan. In an attempt to sidestep this clash, the team at Windwalk has brought its launch slightly forward, and I'd certainly recommend giving it a chance.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: SWORN Patch #12 is LIVE (v0.52.3.0.742)
notes.notes:
- Fixed an issue where the Specter’s Mystic Beam Spell would have fewer hits overall if the user was in Flow 
- Fixed the Golden Hand shrine converting Shop purchases and resources gained from Breakable Pots and Foes into Gold when it shouldn’t
- Added a Tracker to the HUD to let you know how many rewards the Golden Hand Shrine Blessing will convert into Gold 
- Fixed an issue in the Fae Lord Selection Screen where you could change your selection during the animation after choosing an item 
- Fixed an issue where the Galvanic Witch would sometimes dive to an unintended position
- Updated the Galvanic Witch’s rotating Lightning Orb attack to have a longer windup time
- Fixed Fae Lord Selection Screen showing the incorrect button prompt to confirm selection 
- Fixed some UIs showing Xbox button icons when using a PlayStation or Nintendo controller 
- Remove Creative Menu and Console Menu button rebinding in Controller Rebind menu 
- Fixed an issue where the Monk’s Arcane Shield Spell would reduce the Health cost of the Blood Key from Lancelot 
- Updated Oberon’s Blessing “Storm Meditation” requirements so that it is accessible from basic Fury blessings 
- Fixed an issue where King Arthur could become immune to Stagger under certain circumstances 
- Fixed an issue where Critical Damage calculation was different for Lucky Coin Projectiles than it was for attacks 
- Fixed the New Unlocks Available prompt appearing in the Post-Run Summary when it shouldn’t 
- Fixed the spelling of Invisible on the Shadow Step Blessing
- Updated the Description of Splintered Soul to more accurately reflect it’s behavior 
- Fixed an issue where the "Reverberate" Chimes Skill would not follow the "Grazioso" Skill’s target under certain circumstances 
- Fixed an issue where The Treant Scourge's beams could persist on the screen after hitting him with the Rook's Counter while having the 'Revenge' Spell Upgrade 
- Fixed Player's Health bar constantly changing to incorrect values during Secret Boss fight 
- Added an extended hurtbox on King Arthur during some of his attacks to better reflect the position of his body during the animation 
- Fixed The Treasure Goblin's Health bar disappearing if Frozen or Stunned during its escape animation

notes.title: SWORN Patch #11 is LIVE (v0.52.2.0.675)
notes.notes:
- Changed Rook’s Spell ‘Commander’s Crest’ to only trigger on Light Attack, Heavy Attack, or Spell hits to prevent an exploit that could cause infinite Frost Novas
- Changed Gogmagog and Oberon Duo Blessing ‘Berserker’ to only be active during Flow, instead of at max stacks of Fury, and reduced the damage reduction from 50% to 20%
- Changed Ultimate Abilities to now also move over Slowing Tar, preventing the player from being Slowed while active
- Fixed certain ground tiles in Cornwall Township incorrectly inflicting Poison on the player
- Fixed an issue where if the player and the boss died at the same time, and the player had a resurrection token, they wouldn’t be able to use any actions
- Fixed various issues where Living Urns could not be spawned under certain circumstances
- Fixed an issue where the Cliona Blessing ‘Death Engine’ did not require Soul Missiles to hit any target to earn Captured Souls
- Fixed some issues that could prevent players from joining or re-joining a game after certain enemies were encountered in the run
- Fixed an issue where a reward could spawn inside the Rest Area’s Fountain, preventing progression
- Fixed an issue where enemy Frost Resistance was not scaling correctly in multiplayer - foes now have more Frost Resistance in proportion to their Health
- Fixed an issue where Frost Resistance was not increasing the correct amount after a foe was Frozen - it should increase much more each time now
- Fixed an issue where the Oberon Blessing ‘Eye of the Storm’ was creating more Whirlwinds than intended in multiplayer

notes.title: Sworn Patch #10 is LIVE (v0.52.1.0.660)
notes.notes:
- Fixed higher rarities of the ‘Bloody Shadows’ Badb Blessing causing an infinite damage loop with certain combinations - Bloody Shadows now only has a single rarity
- The ‘Royal Treasury’ Lugh Blessing now functions as intended
- Fixed an issue where sometimes, there may be an extra statue during the cutscene at the end of the Secret Biome
- Fixed the Objective display not displaying for certain objective types like the Luna Blossom and Marked Channel events
- Fixed an issue where the ‘First Target’ Lugh Blessing would never wear off
- Fixed an issue where, on certain controllers, the wrong button prompt was displayed in the Fisher King’s cosmetic’s menu
- Fixed an issue where if the Flow status ended while the player was under the effects of a slowing debuff, the debuff would be permanent until Flow was restarted

notes.title: SWORN Update 2 | Changelog and Dev Log (v0.52.0.0.657)
notes.notes:
Soulforged, 

Update 2 is now available! Please watch our Dev Log below for a summary of Early Access so far and a look at this update.

[previewyoutube=fDkn1qlkkcQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Changelog[/h1]

[h2]Public Game Browser[/h2]
- When hosting a game, you can now choose to either host a public or friends only game
- Public games can be tagged with a specific region to help you find games with better connections
- Public games must choose a difficulty to play on. Difficulty cannot be changed at the Difficulty Altar in public games
- On the “Join Game” screen you can now see publicly hosted games with open spots. You can filter these by difficulty and region
- You can also still view all your friends games by selecting the Friends option

[h2]General[/h2]
- Updated visuals for the Main Menu and Pause Menu
- Spells now charge ultimate
- Updated and added several new cutscenes for Camelot and the Secret Biome
- Updated all Player base skin textures
- Updated SFX for Corruptions
- Decreased the difficulty for The Black Knight’s combat trial
- Added an Icon in the HUD displaying the player’s current Dash Charges

[h2]VFX Updates[/h2]
- Updated Player Hit FX
- Improved clarity of Ritual Circle and Earthquake corruptions
- Updated Gore FX across the game
- Updated VFX for all Paragon Effects and Statuses
- Oberon: Added Visuals for Guiding Breeze and Swift Killer Blessings
- Cliona: Added Visuals for when Soul Rend is ready and a hit feedback to the Untouchable Blessing

[h2]Blessings[/h2]
[h3]General[/h3]
- Many On-Kill Blessings work on all foes again (previously, some On-Kill blessings would only work against foes not summoned by other foes, or wouldn’t work in infinitely spawning events)

[h3]Fae Blessing Selection Logic[/h3]
- No longer secretly locks Fae Lords at the start of a run
- Updated logic to more frequently show Light Attack, Heavy Attack, and Spell blessings if you need them
- Updated logic to tune how often you see new mechanics within a Fae Lord you’re already invested in

[h3]Ultimate Blessings[/h3]
- New Icons for Ultimate Blessings
- Ultimate Abilities can now move over gaps and small cover while controlling them (if the ability allows you to move)

[h3]Badb[/h3]
- [Changed] Shades - No longer Backstab, but deal increased base damage
- [Changed] The Thing from the Dark: Updated Icon

[b]Six New Blessings[/b] 
[spoiler]- [New] Stealth Caster: Casting your Spell grants Invisibility, and your Spell doesn’t break Invisibility if recast
- [New] Shadow Step: Go Invisible every 5 dashes for a short duration
- [New] Tragic Aura: Enemies near you build up Bleed stacks passively
- [New] Bloody Shadows: Shades apply additional Bleed
- [New] Shady Business: Triggering Bleed causes a Shade to strike a nearby enemy [/spoiler]

[h3]Beira[/h3]
- [Changed] Deep Chill: Renamed to Frostburn (One of the new Blessings is now called Deep Chill) 
- [Changed] Arctic Bear: Renamed to ‘Arctic Vole’, Updated Icon
- [Removed] Mage Army

[b]Five New Blessings[/b] 
[spoiler]- [New] Bitter End: Frost Novas inflict frost bite
- [New] Roundtable Blessing - Deep Chill: Increase the max stacks of Chill for the entire party
- [New] Frost Torrent: Casting your Ultimate releases a flurry of Frost Novas.
- [New] Ice Age: Your Ultimate inflicts a large amount of Frost Bite
- [New] Seeking Nova: Killing an enemy with five or more stacks of Chill creates a Frost Nova that seeks out nearby enemies [/spoiler]

[h3]Cliona[/h3]
[Removed] Overflowing Soul (a new blessing with the same name is taking its place)

[b]Five New Blessings[/b] 
[spoiler]- [New] Death Engine: When your Souls Missiles strike a foe, Gain Captured Souls (build up Captured Souls to Summon a Living Urn that runs at nearby foes and explodes)
- [New] Accretion: Gain Captured Souls over time from Foes with Weak
- [New] Banshee’s Offering: Your Banshee Companion periodically creates a Living Urn
- [New] Cliona’s Favor: Create two Living Urns when you use your Ultimate
- [New] Overflowing Soul: Living Urns fire Soul Missiles before they expire
- [New] Inescapable End: Soul Missiles deal a portion of their damage to all Weakened foes in a chamber [/spoiler]

[h3]Gogmagog[/h3]
- [Changed] Stony Companion: Updated Icon, and Stone Golem only creates a single Quake where it lands, but base damage is increased
- [Changed] Armored Skin: Now requires a Light, Heavy, Spell, Companion, Dash or Ultimate Gogmagog Blessing to access
- [Changed] Steel Resolve: Now grants a regenerating Damage Shield to the entire party
- [Changed] You may only have one instance of Damage Shield (at base)
- [Changed] Mighty Dash: Only creates a single Quake where you land, but base damage is increased
- [Buff] Quaking Stun: Now creates six Quakes over a wider area instead of one

[b]Nine New Blessings[/b] 
[spoiler]- [New] Concussive slam: Enemies you Stun are Vulnerable (foes deal damage to themselves whenever they attack)
- [New] Flawless: If you don’t take damage for three seconds, your attacks that inflict Stagger deal more damage
- [New] Giant Protection: After using your ultimate, get max stacks of Damage Shield
- [New] Giant Vengeance: When Damage Shield breaks, create six of Quakes in a large area
- [New] Shakedown: When Damage Shield breaks,  attacks that inflict Stagger make enemies Vulnerable for a few seconds
- [New] Bastion: Your Stone Golem hands out Damage Shields to a nearby ally periodically
- [New] Tough Stuff: Take reduced flat damage from all sources
- [New] Fully Armored: Damage Shield can stack up to three times (instead of once)
- [New] Pillage: Enemies drop a crystal shard on death [/spoiler]

[h3]Lugh[/h3]
- [Changed] Golden Squirrel: Updated Icon, Altered scaling of Golden Clover damage
- [Changed] Lucky Dash: Altered scaling of Golden Clover damage

[b]Four New Blessings[/b] 
[spoiler]- [New] Critical Favor: Attacks and Spells that can Critically Hit also build Favor (build Favor to create a Golden Javelin that strikes a nearby foe)
- [New] Favored Clovers: Golden Clovers will flip off foes and grant Favor when caught
- [New] Attack of Opportunity: Golden Javelins can Critically Hit
- [New] Heaven’s Phalanx: Increase the damage of your Golden Javelins, and launch Golden Javelins at nearby foes when you use your Ultimate [/spoiler]

[h3]Mab[/h3]
- [Changed] Bile Mechanic: Now deals increased damage for each stack of Venom on an enemy, and no longer applies Venom on hit
- [Changed] Leech: Now only grants flat healing when killing an Infected foe
- [Buff] Lasting Sting: Now also increases Venom damage the longer it lasts
- [Buff] Waste Not: Shoots Bile always instead of only when enemies are at maximum stacks

[b]Eight New Blessings[/b] 
[spoiler]- [New] Amassing Brood: Broodmothers spawn more Spiderlings periodically
- [New] Chemical X: You periodically shoot Bile
- [New] Dividing Daughters: You have a chance to spawn two Spiderlings instead of one whenever you kill an Infected enemy
- [New] Toxic Incubator: Enemies above a certain Venom threshold are Infected
- [New] Ultimate Arachnid: Increase your Broodmother’s damage whenever an Infected enemy dies
- [New] Caustic Finale: Venomed enemies explode on death, shooting Bile at all nearby enemies
- [New] Feeding Frenzy: Increase the attack speed of your Spiderlings after casting your Ultimate
- [New] Lingering pests: Increase Spiderling duration
- [New] Creeping Venom - Event Shrine Exclusive blessing: Your Spiderlings apply Venom [/spoiler]

[h3]Oberon[/h3]
- [Changed] Flow Mechanic: Now grants Attack Speed and Movement Speed instead of flat damage for its duration, and no longer depends on Fury and has a separate buildup bar to track its progress and duration
- [Changed]  Flood Meditation: No longer mutually exclusive with Storm Meditation, and now grants Flow buildup when you land Fury attacks
- [Changed] Storm Meditation: No longer mutually exclusive with Flood Meditation, and now periodically shoots Chain Lightning from your body while you have ten or more stacks of Fury
- [Changed] Arcing Bolts (Renamed from Enduring storm): Increases damage of Chain Lightning in addition to increased range, but no longer increases bounce limit
- [Changed] Closed Circuit: Increases bounce limit of Chain Lightning in addition to re-bounce effect, but no longer grants bonus damage
- [Changed] Storm Falcon: Updated Icon
- [Removed] Hurricane
- [Removed] Compounding flood
- [Removed] Flurry of Blows
- [Moved] Eternal (Renamed to Static) No Longer a Duo Blessing, now Shrine Event exclusive

[b]Eleven New Blessings[/b] 
[spoiler]- [New] Ebb and Flow: Passively build up Flow while in combat
- [New] Electric Judgement: During your Ultimate, you rapidly strike nearby foes with Chain Lightning
- [New] Furious Lightning: Your Fury attacks release Chain Lightning (Note - This was previously what Storm Meditation did, but the damage has been reduced since it happens without needing ten stacks of Fury. The old Shrine Event blessing also did this, but only with a percentage chance rather than every hit.)
- [New] Eye of the Storm: Your Storm Falcon has two permanent orbiting Whirlwinds
- [New] Tailwind: Increase your maximum stacks of Fury for each active Whirlwind
- [New] Last Wind: Whenever you enter Flow, release a large wave of Whirlwinds
- [New] Lightning Rod: Your Storm Falcon shoots Chain Lightning periodically
- [New] Onslaught: Increase your maximum stacks of Fury
- [New] Rising Current: Chain Lightning deals extra damage based on your Fury
- [New] Whirlwind Shot: While in flow, your Fury attacks launch Whirlwinds
- [New] Roundtable Blessing - Go With The Flow: The entire party passively builds up Flow while in combat [/spoiler]

[h3]Titania[/h3]
- [Changed] Ember Cat: Now has Rising Flame’s old Icon and no longer deals base damage with its fireball
- [Changed] Rising Flame: Updated Icon
- [Moved] Disintegration: No longer a Duo with Cliona
- [Changed] Hot Streak: No longer a Duo with Lugh, and now partially recharges Ignite if the Ignited attack kills at least one Foe, instead of a chance to not consume a charge
- [Changed] Eruption: Rename to Volcanic Retaliation
- [Changed] Fan the Flame: Updated Icon
- [Changed] Lion Claw: Now applies any Ignite on-hit effects, but base damage has been reduced to compensate
- [Removed] Proximity Burn
- [Removed] Burn Bright
- [Removed] Burnout
- [Removed] Wildfire Touch, Wildfire Strike, Wildfire Flourish
- [Changed] Great Ignis: Now grants all Ignite effects a second charge

[b]Fifteen New Blessings[/b] 
[spoiler]- [New] Greater Ignis: Grant all Ignite Effects a third charge
- [New] Scorching Edge: Your Ignite Effects apply Scorched (Scorched Enemies take a burst of flat damage when hit from a Light Attack, Heavy Attack, or Spell from any player)

notes.title: SWORN Early Access | Roadmap Update 1
notes.notes:
Soulforged,

We’re delighted to reveal the SWORN Early Access near-term Roadmap! Thank you for being a part of our valuable community, we appreciate the support and excitement. The launch has been an overwhelming experience – we are blessed – and love seeing all the content and reading your feedback. 

We want to keep the momentum going by delivering a roadmap focused on three core steps: quality-of-life improvements, expanding the game, and deepening the gameplay experience. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Xi8vCp7.png[/img]

More balancing and fixes are on the way, followed by a minor update to add pausing in solo runs, WASD rebinding and an Ultimate ready indicator. 

Improving the foundations of SWORN is a priority – we have four weapon revisions planned, blessing revisions; and more control on randomness. We also hear you on matchmaking, so we’re looking into the possibility of a lobby browser. 

Camelot grows! As you can see, the asset features a work-in-progress look at Biome 5, permeated with a lunar surface. We’ll reveal more about the location and its bosses on the journey to releasing Major Update 1. 

To enrich community value, we’d also like to implement a competitive mode with challenges and leaderboards. The end goal is to release SWORN as a finely-tuned roguelike experience that offers deep, polished gameplay with tons of replay value. 

Community feedback is immensely important to us, so the content stipulated is by no means exhaustive. We will continue to refine and craft SWORN with your feedback in mind. 

Thanks again, 

The journey through Camelot continues!
